g.text: Task feature buffers: observed transient allocation peaks
8192 environments, native float64 inputs, C layout. Medians of three independent tracemalloc peaks.
Inputs, decoded state and existing runtime buffers are prepared before tracing; peaks are not process RSS.
Direct feature savings are not overall memory or training-throughput savings. Raw latency samples and
all 44 scenarios per version are retained; complete-step time gains remain inconclusive.
